summaries.text:
Amends the Internal Revenue Code to deny an income tax deduction for expenses in connection with the cutting of redwood timber if: (1) such timber is either old-growth redwood timber or disqualified securitized redwood timber; or (2) it is transported in an unprocessed state.

Imposes an excise tax on the cutting of any taxable redwood timber, to be paid by the holder of the economic interest in the timber.
